name: tenkacloud-ac26-crypto-battle-game
description: Pure game model (state / op / reducer) for the PROVE / LEAK / HUNT advanced-cryptography Battle. No AWS, no network -- reducer.ts / types.ts never import @tenkacloud/coordination-plugin-sdk (see AGENTS.md). src/coordination-plugin.test.ts is the one exception: it exercises ../../coordination/crypto-battle.ts's plugin wrapper against a bun:test-mocked stub of that SDK (Issue #486 PR3), never the real package. react / react-dom / their @types below are devDependencies only, needed because game/tsconfig.json's include also typechecks ../portal/**/*.tsx (Issue #486 PR4) and src/portal.test.ts renders those plugins via react-dom/server -- game/src itself imports neither.
